templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: A standard mutual NDA for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties evaluating a potential business relationship.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used between the parties
fields.placeholder: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date on which this agreement comes into effect

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.description: Whether the agreement expires after a set period or continues until terminated

fields.label: MNDA Term Length (years)
fields.description: Number of years the agreement lasts (if set to expire)

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: How long Confidential Information is protected after the agreement ends

fields.label: Confidentiality Term Length (years)
fields.description: Number of years confidential information must be protected (if not in perpetuity)

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern this agreement

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: The courts with exclusive jurisdiction over disputes
fields.placeholder: courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: Modifications
fields.description: Any modifications to the standard MNDA terms

fields.label: Party 1
fields.description: First party to the agreement

fields.label: Party 2
fields.description: Second party to the agreement
